title: Slice integrals over a C¹ chart via the injective area formula (parent steps 1–3)
statement: Notation: ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); n := m + k; P := WithLp 2 (ℝᵐ × ℝᵏ), the Euclidean product, whose volume is the Lebesgue measure of the finite-dimensional inner product space P (instance measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace); toLp = WithLp.toLp 2; Hᵏ = μHE[k] (applied to an arbitrary set it is the Hausdorff outer measure); Lᵈ = volume; normDet = LinearMap.normDet, applied to the underlying linear map; DF(x) = fderiv ℝ F x (the zero map where F is not differentiable); j : ℝᵏ →L[ℝ] P is the continuous linear map z ↦ toLp(0, z), in Lean (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)) (j z = toLp(0, z) holds by rfl). For an open partial homeomorphism Φ from ℝⁿ to P: O := Φ.source and Ω := Φ.target (both open), Φ⁻¹ := Φ.symm, ρ := ψ ∘ Φ⁻¹ : P → ℝᴺ (in Lean ψ ∘ Φ.symm), h(w) := φ(ψ(Φ⁻¹ w))·ofReal(normDet(Dρ(w) ∘ j)) for w ∈ P, and F := 1_{Φ(B)}·h, i.e. F = (Φ '' B).indicator h. Statement. Let m, k, N ∈ ℕ and let Φ be an open partial homeomorphism from ℝⁿ to P such that Φ.symm is C¹ on Ω. Let ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ be C¹ on O and injective on O, and let G : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ satisfy (Φ u).fst = G(u) for all u ∈ O. Let B ⊆ O be Borel and let φ : ℝᴺ → [0, ∞] be any function for which the injective area formula holds in dimension k: (AF) for every open V ⊆ ℝᵏ, every χ : ℝᵏ → ℝᴺ that is C¹ on V and injective on V, and every Borel S ⊆ V, ∫_{χ(S)} φ dHᵏ = ∫_S φ(χ(z))·ofReal(normDet(Dχ(z))) dLᵏ(z). Then for every y ∈ ℝᵐ: ∫_{ψ(B ∩ G⁻¹{y})} φ dHᵏ = ∫_{ℝᵏ} F(toLp(y, z)) dLᵏ(z). No measurability of φ and no differentiability of Φ is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m) (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Rn (m + k)) (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ Φ.source → InjOn ψ Φ.source → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ.symm Φ.target → (∀ u ∈ Φ.source, (Φ u).fst = G u) → ∀ B ⊆ Φ.source, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, (∀ (V : Set (Rn k)) (χ : Rn k → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ V → InjOn χ V → ∀ S ⊆ V, MeasurableSet S → ∫⁻ x in χ '' S, φ x ∂μHE[k] = ∫⁻ z in S, φ (χ z) * ENNReal.ofReal ((fderiv ℝ χ z).toLinearMap.normDet)) → ∀ y : Rn m, ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k] = ∫⁻ z : Rn k, (Φ '' B).indicator (fun w ↦ φ (ψ (Φ.symm w)) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) w).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (y, z))
